rapport_notes: Joanna is warm, patient, and responsive; she uses affirming language ('Of course,' 'No problem') and holds space for the customer to answer questions fully.
process_discipline_notes: No differentiators repeated across stages; silence protocol not rigorously held after open-ended questions, but no rules violation.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep does not frame the call with a time-boxed ask or explicit promise of an accurate quote in return. Immediately launches into logistics probing: 'First off, you're planning to do this move on Friday...'
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked after logistics probing has already started. Joanna asked address, storage size, contents, and parking details before asking: 'do you have any special instructions, concerns or stressors about moving in general that you want me to take note of at this time?'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised damage concern ('no damage. That's the only things that I'm worried about.'). Joanna answered immediately with coverage info but did not probe deeper or ask 'what else is on your mind' — one answer, straight pivot to pricing details.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: Covered in Stage 1 as a direct answer to the customer's damage concern: 'Rest assured that we do not take daily contracted workers. Our guys are the most weeded movers in the industry. And also we provided to $2,000 coverage for any repair, replacement reimbursement for any accidental damages.'
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: Never mentioned. 'Meet Your Mover' or any reference to who will be on the crew, named crew lead, or team continuity not covered anywhere.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Covered in Stage 2 pricing pitch: 'We also provide an on time guarantee tailor if we run late, we provide discounts by the end of the day.'
evidence_quotes.communication: Not covered anywhere. No mention of day-before call, named crew lead, inbox updates, or any proactive communication protocol.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full anchor with personalization: 'Typically, a ten by fifteen storage usually takes five and a half to seven and a half hours to complete. Now, in your case, if it's just about 70–75 percent of the items we're moving out of the storage... I'm just estimating it more on the four to six hour mark, which is an estimated budget of $1,504.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_window: Covered: 'But of course, if it takes shorter than that, that's fine, you only pay for how long it will take after the two and a half hour minimum.'
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: Covered: 'if we go over that we only charge in fifteen minute increment' and 'the shorter the move, the lower the cost.'
evidence_quotes.commit_to_rate: Not mentioned. No reference to '100k moves' experience framing or commitment language.
evidence_quotes.self_prep_tip: Not mentioned. No discussion of pre-move prep reducing labor cost.
evidence_quotes.does_that_feel_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Joanna immediately pivots to booking: 'Okay. Now, if that's all good with you, I can definitely get you on the schedule.'
evidence_quotes.rate_lock: Not mentioned. No statement that 'your rate locks when you book.'
evidence_quotes.explicit_close_ask: Implicit close (assumed booking) but no explicit ask like 'Would you like our help with your move?' or 'Shall I get you on the calendar?' Joanna says 'I can definitely get you on the schedule' but does not wait for an affirmative close from the customer; instead, proceeds directly to confirmation email logistics.

top_strength: Joanna gathered detailed logistics information systematically (address, storage layout, contents, parking, oversized items, fragile items) and personalized the time estimate accurately to the customer's specific scenario (70–75% load reduction).
coaching_note: Start every call with a framing quid pro quo ('Let's ask a few quick questions to build you an accurate quote, should take about six minutes'), ask the customer's agenda before diving into logistics details, and probe at least one layer deeper when they raise a concern — in this case, 'no damage' deserved a follow-up like 'anything else on your mind about the move?' before pitching coverage; also, 'Communication' (day-before call, crew lead, updates) was never mentioned and should have landed as part of the Stage 2 takeaway.
